unit.source: (a) Given the two discount series of 30-10-2(1/2) % and 25-15-2%, which is better? (b) Given the discount series 15-15% and the single rate of 30%, which is better?
unit.instructions: (a) Given the two discount series of 30-10-2(1/2) % and 25-15-2%, which is better? (b) Given the discount series 15-15% and the single rate of 30%, which is better?

branches.A: The series 30-10-2(1/2)% and the single rate of 25% are better
branches.B: The single rate of 25% and the series 15-15% are better
branches.C: The series 30-10-2(1/2) % and the series 15-15% are better
branches.D: The series 25-15-2% and the single rate of 30% are better
branches.E: The series 30-10-2(1/2)% is better, but there is no difference between the series 15-15% and the single rate of 30%
branches.F: Both discount series are equally beneficial
branches.G: The series 25-15-2% is better, and the series 15-15% and the single rate of 30% are equally beneficial
branches.H: The series 25-15-2% and the series 15-15% are better
branches.I: The series 25-15-2% and the single rate of 25% are better
branches.J: The series 30-10-2(1/2) % and the single rate of 30% are better
